methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Indonesia at 75.53% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 18.0%, followed by Samsung Internet at 3.48%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 75.53% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/indonesia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Chrome (75.53%), Safari (18.0%), Samsung Internet (3.48%) in October 2026.
